html:
SMTO-LLM-0048 — The AI model sent back a reply with no answer in it

GUID: abc7e282-c733-40c3-bae4-0c47269d4214
Slug: assistant-message-missing
Domain: LLM · Subsystem: llm

What happened

  • The AI model replied, but the reply was missing the actual answer SMTO reads, so SMTO stopped this step. Nothing in that reply was carried out.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Look at the steps already shown for this task in the conversation and note which ones finished before the error. Work finished before this reply still stands, so you only need SMTO to continue, not redo it.
  2. Open Settings › Setup › Model routing and pick a different model for Main (and Helper, if one is set), then save. The empty reply comes from the model server, so a different model or server usually answers correctly.
  3. If someone else runs your AI model server, tell them SMTO received replies with no assistant message and ask them to check its chat setup. The fix belongs on the model server, which SMTO can't change for you.
  4. Send a new message asking SMTO to continue from where it stopped, without repeating the steps that already finished. New messages use the model you just chose, and SMTO can build on the steps that already finished.

What success looks like

  • SMTO replies normally and the task moves on to its next step without this error.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages your AI model server or SMTO. You don't need to shorten or clear the conversation; this problem isn't caused by its length.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The model response has no message object in its choice, or the message role is not 'assistant', so the native-protocol validator rejected the turn before any tool call was dispatched.

What this means

  • The chosen result lacks the assistant-message object or required assistant role, so there is no supported message to validate. This category concerns model preparation or response acceptance. It does not reverse earlier operations or establish their outcome; their receipts remain authoritative.

Why this can happen

  • The chosen result lacks the assistant-message object or required assistant role, so there is no supported message to validate.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare the response's message object and role with the negotiated chat API; inspect the serving template if another API's shape was returned.

How to fix it

  • Inspect the raw response from the endpoint configured in Settings › Setup › Model routing: choices[0].message must be present with role 'assistant'. Correct the serving stack's OpenAI-compatible chat API or chat template, or route to an endpoint that returns standard chat-completion messages; do not disable protocol validation.
  • Check the model API and chat-template compatibility, then correct the response protocol at the serving endpoint.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • The chosen response contains a supported assistant message and passes envelope validation.

What not to do

  • Do not replay prior successful operations to repair a later model response.
  • Do not disable protocol validation or treat this representation failure as input-context overflow.

Technical notes

  • This category concerns model preparation or response acceptance. It does not reverse earlier operations or establish their outcome; their receipts remain authoritative.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
